column1: # Ground truth for the stratified sample drawn by scripts/sample_loci.py.
# One row per sampled token position: the id printed on the review sheet, and the
# reading settled by looking at the ~630 dpi Internet Archive facsimile.
#  * The truth is the whole whitespace-delimited printed word the sampled box sits
#    in. An engine that split or merged that word is therefore wrong, because it is.
#  * 1881 orthography is kept verbatim (á, ó, dia, Setiembre, mallorquin), and so
#    are the author's own spellings. This is a transcription, not a correction.
#  * Words broken at the line end keep their hyphen (fó-, conti-, volumi-); the
#    stitching happens later in the pipeline, identically for every engine.
#  * Small capitals are recorded as ordinary capitalisation (Junio, Noviembre,
#    Columna): they are a typographic device, not a different word. Engines that
#    emit JUNIO are counted wrong here, and the report separates that class out.
#  * An empty truth means the sampled box holds no text at all -- a stray mark, an
#    ornamental rule, a speck of dirt the geometry engine took for a word.
